items.markdown:
A salmon sperm facial is `a regenerative skin treatment that uses purified DNA fragments (polydeoxyribonucleotides or PDRN) extracted from salmon sperm cells` , typically delivered via microneedling or topical serums.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)[[2]](https://www.laseraway.com/articles/rejuran/skin-rejuvenation-what-are-salmon-dna-skin-treatments/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C4zqkmdQkw4&t=1)[[4]](https://thespaatmps.com/med-spa-blog/dont-let-the-name-scare-you-why-the-salmon-sperm-facial-is-trending)

### How It Works

- **Purified DNA:** The treatment does not use raw sperm. Instead, it uses hydrolyzed, purified polynucleotide chains sourced from wild salmon.[[1]](https://www.vogue.com/article/salmon-sperm-facial)[[2]](https://www.laseraway.com/articles/rejuran/skin-rejuvenation-what-are-salmon-dna-skin-treatments/)
- **Cellular Stimulation:** The DNA fragments signal fibroblast cells in the skin to produce more collagen and elastin, boost microcirculation, and accelerate tissue repair.[[1]](https://drkormeilidermatology.com/salmon-sperm-facial-santa-monica-the-secret-to-radiant-rejuvenated-skin/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C4zqkmdQkw4&t=1)
- **Delivery:** It is usually paired with skin barrier disruption tools like **SkinPen® microneedling** or laser treatments to help the serum penetrate deep into the dermis. You can learn more about how this is offered through providers like [LaserAway](https://www.laseraway.com/articles/rejuran/skin-rejuvenation-what-are-salmon-dna-skin-treatments/).[[1]](https://metroderm.org/salmon-sperm-facial-what-it-is-how-it-works-and-why-its-the-next-big-thing-in-anti-aging-skin-care/)[[2]](https://skinrefinemedspa.com/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial/)[[3]](https://drkormeilidermatology.com/salmon-sperm-facial-santa-monica-the-secret-to-radiant-rejuvenated-skin/)[[4]](https://www.laseraway.com/articles/rejuran/skin-rejuvenation-what-are-salmon-dna-skin-treatments/)

### Potential Benefits

- **Hydration and Glow:** Deeply plumps the skin and improves moisture retention.
- **Texture and Tone:** Helps soften fine lines, reduce acne scars, and minimize enlarged pores.
- **Elasticity:** Strengthens the skin barrier and improves overall firmness without adding artificial volume like traditional fillers.[[1]](https://metroderm.org/salmon-sperm-facial-what-it-is-how-it-works-and-why-its-the-next-big-thing-in-anti-aging-skin-care/)[[2]](https://www.vogue.com/article/salmon-sperm-facial)[[3]](https://skinrefinemedspa.com/treatments/skin-rejuvenation/salmon-sperm-dna-aka-salmon-sperm-facial/)[[4]](https://www.laseraway.com/articles/rejuran/skin-rejuvenation-what-are-salmon-dna-skin-treatments/)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C4zqkmdQkw4&t=1)

### Risks and Considerations

- **Not FDA-Approved for Injection:** While topical applications and microneedling with cosmetic serums are widely available in med spas, injectable forms (such as Rejuran injections) lack full FDA approval in the United States.[[1]](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/shopping/salmon-sperm-skin-care-rcna227796)[[2]](https://www.laseraway.com/articles/rejuran/skin-rejuvenation-what-are-salmon-dna-skin-treatments/)
- **Allergies and Infection:** People with severe fish or seafood allergies should avoid the treatment. Improper sterile technique during microneedling or injections can lead to irritation, redness, or infection.[[1]](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/shopping/salmon-sperm-skin-care-rcna227796)[[2]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)
- **Downtime and Cost:** Side effects include mild redness, swelling, or tiny pinpricks that typically fade within 24 to 72 hours, and results require a series of multiple sessions.[[1]](https://skinrefinemedspa.com/treatments/skin-rejuvenation/salmon-sperm-dna-aka-salmon-sperm-facial/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L_VC8_jfmdk)[[3]](https://www.laseraway.com/articles/rejuran/skin-rejuvenation-what-are-salmon-dna-skin-treatments/)
